# Thomas Roberts Realty

> Thomas Roberts is a real estate agent with Silvercreek Realty Group, serving buyers and
> sellers throughout Southeast Idaho, including Idaho Falls, Pocatello, Rexburg, Ammon,
> Blackfoot, and Chubbuck.
